info.name: Community Management
info.description:
**You must apply for access to the Marketing Developer Platform in order to use these APIs. See the** [**Developer Portal**](https://developer.linkedin.com/product-catalog/marketing/page-management) **on how to apply.**

This collection aims to focus on different Community Management use cases, for example, social action notifications, and should be used with the **community-management-env-versioning** environment.

\--All requests for the Community Management API collection are in the Restli 2.0 format--

AuthorizationOAuth 2.0

item.name: Social Actions Notifications
Organization Social Actions Notifications - Push Workflow
2. Create a share with Company Mention

request.description:
Mention a company name by using the annotations. [Learn more](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/community-management/shares/share-api?tabs=http#share-text-and-mentions) by viewing our public documentation.

This example uses the LinkedIn organization.

[Create a subscription](https://docs.microsoft.com/linkedin/marketing/integrations/community-management/organizations/organization-social-action-notifications?tabs=http#creating-and-updating-subscriptions) record to include the webhook URL where your app will receive notifications. The subscription request will only succeed if the subscribing member is an administrator of the organization being subscribed to.

Retrieve Subscriptions details such as webhook url and expiration for your application and registered user. [Learn more](https://docs.microsoft.com/linkedin/marketing/integrations/community-management/organizations/organization-social-action-notifications?tabs=http#retrieve-subscriptions-by-key) by viewing our public documentation.

Retrieve all the subscriptions details such as webhook url and expiration for the logged in user. [Learn more](https://docs.microsoft.com/linkedin/marketing/integrations/community-management/organizations/organization-social-action-notifications?tabs=http#retrieve-subscriptions-for-an-authenticated-member) by viewing our online documentation.

[Remove a subscription](https://docs.microsoft.com/linkedin/marketing/integrations/community-management/organizations/organization-social-action-notifications?tabs=http#remove-a-subscription) for a your developer application and Organization.

item.description: Registered webhook URLs will receive notifications from LinkedIn for subscribed events.

item.name: 3. Retrieve Notifications for the authenticated member's organization

request.description: [Learn more](https://docs.microsoft.com/linkedin/marketing/integrations/community-management/organizations/organization-social-action-notifications?tabs=http#pull-organizational-notifications) by viewing our public documentation.

item.description: Notifications for the authenticated member’s organizations can be queried using a criteria finder. Notifications are retained and available to pull for 60 days.

The Organization Social Actions Notifications API enables your app to notify members about activity on their LinkedIn Company Pages. Use this API to build real-time streams for activity on LinkedIn Company Pages.

See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/organizations/follower-statistics

item.description: Fully parametrized calls for the organizationalEntityFollowerStatistics API (lifetime + time-bound), using environment variables for organization id and time range/granularity. Omitting `timeIntervals` returns lifetime stats. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/organizations/page-statistics

See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/organizations/page-statistics

item.description: Fully parametrized calls for the organizationPageStatistics and brandPageStatistics APIs (lifetime + time-bound), using environment variables for organization/brand id and time range/granularity. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/organizations/page-statistics

Shares with no actions/impressions are omitted from the response. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/organizations/share-statistics

item.name: Share Statistics for Specific UGC Posts

request.description: Retrieves lifetime share statistics for specific UGC Post URNs (ugc_post_id, ugc_post_id2 env vars). Time-bound statistics is not supported for specific UGC Post queries. Posts with no actions/impressions are omitted from the response. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/organizations/share-statistics

item.description: Fully parametrized calls for the organizationalEntityShareStatistics API (lifetime, time-bound, specific shares, specific UGC posts), using environment variables for organization id, time range/granularity, and share/UGC post ids. This endpoint returns organic statistics only (sponsored activity excluded). See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/organizations/share-statistics
This API gets the statistics for Organization, Page and for Share.

item.name: Enable or Disable Comments on a Thread

request.description: Enables (OPEN) or disables (CLOSED) comments on a share/UGC post thread (thread URNs only, not comment URNs). Disabling deletes all existing comments; reactions are unaffected. actor must be an organization or person URN. Returns 202 Accepted on success. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/social-metadata-api

item.description: Read and manage social actions (reactions and comments) on shares/UGC posts/comments via the socialMetadata API, using environment variables for entity URNs, actor, and comments state. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/social-metadata-api

item.name: Reactions API

request.description: Retrieves a single reaction by compound key (actor + entity). Actor can be a person or organization URN; entity can be a share, UGC post, or comment URN. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/reactions-api

item.name: Batch Get a Collection of Reactions

request.description: Batch retrieves multiple reactions at once by their (actor, entity) compound keys. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/reactions-api

Retrieves all reactions on a given share/UGC post entity, sorted by CHRONOLOGICAL, REVERSE_CHRONOLOGICAL (default), or RELEVANCE via the reaction_sort_order env var. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/reactions-api

item.name: Create a Reaction on a Share

request.description: Creates a reaction (default LIKE, via reaction_type env var) on a share/UGC post/activity on behalf of the actor (organization or person URN). Returns 201 Created. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/reactions-api

response.name: Create a Reaction on a Share

item.name: Create a Reaction on a Comment

request.description: Creates a reaction (default LIKE, via reaction_type env var) on a specific comment (identified by parent activity_id + comment_id) on behalf of the actor. Returns 201 Created. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/reactions-api
Deletes a reaction by its (actor, entity) compound key. Returns 204 No Content on success. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/reactions-api

item.description: Create, retrieve, and delete reactions (an expansion of likes) on shares/UGC posts/comments, replacing the legacy socialActions likes functionality, using environment variables for actor/entity URNs and reaction type. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/reactions-api

item.name: Video Analytics API

request.description: Retrieves lifetime (no aggregation/timeRange) video analytics for a video ugcPost entity, using the metric type set in video_analytics_type (VIDEO_VIEW, VIEWER, TIME_WATCHED, TIME_WATCHED_FOR_VIDEO_VIEWS). See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/video-analytics-api

Retrieves video analytics for a video ugcPost entity aggregated by DAY or WEEK (via video_analytics_aggregation) within a time range (start inclusive, end exclusive, epoch ms). See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/video-analytics-api

item.description: Retrieves watch time, video views, and viewer analytics for a video ugcPost entity. Likes/comments are not returned here (use Social Actions API). See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/video-analytics-api

item.name: Documents API

request.description: Registers a document upload. Returns an uploadUrl (for uploading the raw file via a separate PUT/upload-file request) and the new document URN. Copy the returned document URN into document_id for subsequent requests. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/documents-api

Retrieves a single document asset (owner, status, downloadUrl, downloadUrlExpiresAt) by its document URN. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/documents-api
Batch retrieves multiple document assets by their URNs in a single call. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/documents-api

Creates a Post that attaches a previously-uploaded document (via its document URN) as media content. Returns 201 Created with the new post URN in the x-restli-id response header. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/documents-api
Retrieves a Post (and its attached document content) by post URN. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/documents-api

Batch retrieves multiple posts (and their attached document content) by post URNs. Requires the X-RestLi-Method: batch_get header. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/documents-api

item.description: Manages Document assets (PPT/PPTX/DOC/DOCX/PDF, max 100MB / 300 pages) for use in Document ads and organic posts: upload initialization, retrieval, and creating/reading Posts with attached document content. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/documents-api

item.name: Polls API

request.description: Creates a Post with Poll content (2-4 options, max question length 140 chars, max option length 30 chars). Returns 201 Created with the new post URN in the x-restli-id response header. Poll content cannot be updated after creation. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/poll-post-api

Retrieves a single Post with Poll content (including option vote counts and settings) by its ugcPost URN. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/poll-post-api

Batch retrieves multiple posts (Poll or other content types, e.g. Carousel) by ugcPost URNs. Requires the X-RestLi-Method: batch_get header. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/poll-post-api

item.description: Create and retrieve Poll Posts (2-4 options, 1/3/7/14 day duration, single-select voting). Polls are created/managed via the Posts API and cannot be updated after creation. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/poll-post-api

item.name: Celebration API

request.description: Retrieves a single Post with Celebration content (type, media template/image, tagged recipients) by its ugcPost URN. Note: Celebration posts cannot be created via this API (returns 400) - fetch only. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/celebration-post-api

response.name: Get Celebration Content (Post)

request.description: Batch retrieves multiple posts (Celebration or other content types, e.g. Carousel) by ugcPost URNs. Requires the X-RestLi-Method: BATCH_GET header. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/celebration-post-api

item.description: Fetches Celebration content type Posts (e.g. CELEBRATE_ANNIVERSARY, CELEBRATE_AWARD, CELEBRATE_MILESTONE, etc.). Read-only: Celebration posts cannot be created through this API (would return 400). See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/celebration-post-api

item.name: Little Text Format Examples

request.description: Creates a Post whose commentary uses `little` text format: a MentionElement (@[Name](urn)) tagging an organization, plus a HashtagTemplate ({hashtag|#|tag}). See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/little-text-format

Creates a Post whose commentary uses the simpler `little` HashtagElement syntax (#word) rather than the HashtagTemplate. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/little-text-format

item.name: Create Post with Escaped Reserved Characters (Bullet List)

request.description: Creates a Post demonstrating escaping of `little` reserved characters (e.g. '*' must be escaped as '\\*') so they render as literal plaintext instead of being parsed as little syntax. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/little-text-format

response.name: Little-Text-Get

item.description: Examples of the `little` text format used in the Posts API commentary field: MentionElement, HashtagElement, HashtagTemplate, and escaping reserved characters. `little` is not a separate endpoint - these all POST to /posts. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/little-text-format

item.name: Comments API

request.description: Retrieves a single comment by its ID, scoped under the share/ugcPost/comment (thread) URN in the path. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/comments-api

item.name: Batch Get a Collection of Comments

request.description: Batch retrieves multiple comments by ID on the same thread (share/ugcPost/comment URN). See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/comments-api
Retrieves all top-level comments on a given share/ugcPost (thread URN). See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/comments-api

Resolves nested (reply) comments for a given parent commentUrn (composite URN of thread activityUrn + comment ID). See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/comments-api

Creates a top-level comment on a share/ugcPost (thread). Returns the new comment ID in the x-restli-id response header. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/comments-api

item.name: Create a Comment on a Comment (Nested)

request.description: Creates a nested (reply) comment by including the parentComment field (composite URN of thread activityUrn + parent comment ID). See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/comments-api

Edits the text of an existing comment via a partial-update patch (only message.text/attributes may be modified). Requires the X-RestLi-Method: PARTIAL_UPDATE header. The actor query param is only required when editing as an organization. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/comments-api
Deletes a comment by ID. The actor query param is only required when deleting as an organization. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/comments-api

item.description: Read and write comments on shares/ugcPosts (socialActions/comments), including nested (reply) comments, edit, and delete. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/comments-api
